description: This file defines the MultipartUploader class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling multipart uploads to Glacier. It includes methods to create, manage, and resume multipart uploads, handling part size validation, stream decoration for hashing, and obtaining upload state from the service.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Encapsulates the logic for performing multipart uploads to AWS Glacier, including creating upload states, handling part sizes, creating parts, and completing uploads.

methods.name: getStateFromService
methods.description: Retrieves the upload state from Glacier service using a paginator to list parts and reconstruct the upload state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartUploader with a Glacier client, source data, and configuration options.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Defines command names and identifiers used during the upload workflow.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Validates and returns the configured part size, ensuring it is a power of two within the allowed range.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Reads a segment of the source data to create a multipart upload part, computing hashes and preparing the HTTP body.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes the completion of a part upload, updating the upload state with checksum and size information.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters for initiating a multipart upload, such as part size and description.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Calculates overall archive size and checksum to finalize the multipart upload.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Wraps a stream with hashing layers to compute SHA256 and Tree Hash values during data transfer.

methods.name: parseRange
methods.description: Parses a Glacier 'bytes' range string into a part index and size.
